title: Forged in Fire
description:
S04 E23 — Viking Edition
Competitors march into a dry moat where they resurrect old swords and forge them into a Viking Seax, using the time-tested coal forge; the finalists return home to recreate a pair of deadly Viking War Axes.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S02 E05 — Viking Sword
In a race against time, four bladesmiths have to salvage material from a car and forge a blade; two will make it to the final round where they will have just five days to create a Viking sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S04 E21 — Ultimate Champions Edition
Five returning champions must earn a spot at one of the four anvils; the four remaining smiths are given cubes to forge blades in the infamous canister Damascus challenge; then, the finalists return to their home forges to recreate the Tai Chi sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S05 E06 — Ultimate Team Challenge
Four master smiths compete alongside their apprentices to forge an iconic weapon of warfare: the trench knife; each team must work together, tagging in and out every half hour, with only one smith allowed to touch the knife at a time.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S07 E34 — Super Champion Edition
Four former champions return to the forge to compete; after the first round, three move on to a fit-and-finish round; the finalist is tasked with recreating a Cossack Shashka and must defeat one of the judges to be named Super Champion.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E34 — Judges Takeover: Ben Abbott
Four smiths must recreate the billhook knife; the remaining two must recreate the Sutton Hoo Sword.

title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E32 — Judges Takeover: Doug Marcaida
Four smiths recreate a weapon from the mind of judge Doug Marcaida; the remaining two must recreate the Supersized Kortada.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E12 — Season Two Finale
The final four compete to determine the winner of the $100,000 prize and the title of Top Shot; the most-intense series of challenges of the competition takes place.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E13 — Behind the Bullet
The marksmen discuss their skills, strategies and most controversial shots.

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E05 — Throwdown Showdown
The teams call each other out with primitive weapons; two shooters compete with the most powerful weapon ever used on "Top Shot."

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E01 — The Gauntlet
A shoot off using one of the most powerful hand guns in history; a race where each team must carry a pole weighing over 200 pounds between eight foot tall firing platforms. An elimination challenge inspired by the stagecoaches of the old west.

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E04 — The Bulldog Gatling
The legendary Gatling gun is introduced; team challenge with a historic pistol; two marksmen shoot it out.

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E02 — Down and Dirty
Teams get down and dirty with the legendary AK-47; an extreme obstacle course with mud pits barbed wire and exploding mortars; two shooters face a friend or foe challenge with a military and police pistol.

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E03 — Slug It Out
Shotgun skills are tested with a head-to-head speed shooting challenge; tension escalates on both teams; an elimination challenge unlike any before, featuring an elaborate machine, a Glock 34 and a line of non-stop cannonballs.
